_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Fastest-hiring companies in a segment

description:
Best for: who is hiring fastest in a market, such as "which companies added the most sales roles in Berlin this week?".
Returns: companies ranked by new roles over 7 days, each with boards, open roles, baseline weekly average, ratio and a spike flag, plus as_of and the method.
Input tips: {"segment": {"function": "sales", "city": "berlin"}}, {"segment": {"ats": ["greenhouse"]}} or {"segment": {"companies": ["stripe.com"]}}; no segment ranks every company. A function or city segment is this week's leaderboard list (at most 50). Country and size are not filters.
Needs: an API key on the segment plan (49 USD a month); else subscription_required with plan_page.
Not for: one company's detail (use company_hiring_brief).

limit.description: Companies to return, fastest first. Default 50.

segment.description: Which companies to rank. Leave it out to rank every company the history store reads.

city.description: A city slug from the leaderboard, such as "berlin", "new-york" or "remote"; with function, both must match.

companies.description: Companies, as a domain ("stripe.com"), a board token ("greenhouse:airbnb") or a company key from an earlier answer ("domain:stripe.com").

function.description: Companies on this week's leaderboard for this function: the most new roles in it over 7 days, at most 50.

name: segment_hiring_ranking

api_version.description: Date of this answer's shape; it changes only when a field is removed or changes meaning.

as_of.description: ISO 8601 time the data was published by its source or fetched from it. A cached answer keeps the time of its fetch.

baseline_roles.description: New roles in the baseline weeks.

baseline_weeks.description: Baseline weeks the store knows, 0 to 4.

company.description: The company key: domain:..., name:...|country, or board:ats:slug for a board with no company map.

segment_new_7d.description: With function or city: the company's new roles in that function and city over 7 days, which the ranking orders by.

source.description: Who the data comes from, to cite and to check it against.

title: Fastest-hiring companies in a segment
